name: isFreeOfConnectWiseAppExposure
definition: True when the tenant's full service-principal list was read, the reads cover all seven ConnectWise apps, and none of ConnectWise Cloud Backup (506e08f9-6e9a-4da4-942b-a099a03644ae), ConnectWise Cloud Management - MS Teams (24205314-2b89-4e07-a2a4-579e898a5640), ConnectWise Cloud Management (2399d300-6fca-4e6a-a686-399fefe75b83), ConnectWise Cloud Management - Exchange Online (b78f6a77-d4e5-46fb-87e5-d1648bd02519), ConnectWise Cloud Management - MS Graph (0de14c77-b9b0-4137-9360-34878a929827), ConnectWise Cloud Management - Partner Center (412dcf96-176d-4b3a-a1b0-4981ad66971e) and ConnectWise Cloud Management - SharePoint Online (b2b55f5b-7758-4719-8d8f-88ae172e6bdb) has a service principal in it, enabled or disabled.
population: service principals in one Microsoft Entra tenant whose appId is one of the seven ConnectWise apps in scope for the October 2026 advisory (J.J. 18 Oct 2026: the two named as abused and the five other Cloud Management apps whose ids Huntress and BleepingComputer publish)
evidenceRequiredForTrue: A complete, unpaged, error-free servicePrincipals read filtered by the seven appIds that returns no record for any of them, and every app's per-app role feed present in the body (data or a stepError marker), so the reads are known to cover all seven apps.

changeLog.change: Registered with the ConnectWise OAuth app exposure transform; proposed, no requirement reads it yet.
A present but disabled service principal now reads false (Exposed, risk low): it can be re-enabled and keeps its consent, grants and credentials, so the customer must remove it.

Scope widened from two to seven ConnectWise apps (J.J. 18 Oct 2026): any of the seven present reads false. True also needs every app's per-app role feed in the body; reads that cover fewer apps are Not evaluated.

notes: Threat-specific (ConnectWise multitenant OAuth app abuse, Microsoft Threat Intelligence and Huntress, 16-17 Oct 2026). An empty filtered list is the measured answer 'none of the seven apps is present', so emptyPopulationMeans is compliant; a refused, errored or paged read is Not evaluated. A present but disabled service principal reads false (Exposed, risk low): it can be re-enabled and keeps its consent, grants and credentials. allowedCategories is empty until Integration-Service maps an RTA row; the intended home is Azure AD (One-Click). Since revision 3 a body from reads that cover only some of the seven apps (no per-app role feed for the others) is Not evaluated, so Integration-Service must widen its reads before an RTA row maps this key.
